general_invariant_potential: V(phi) = -mu^2 |phi|^2 + lambda |phi|^4 + O(|phi|^6) -- function of |phi|^2 only
conclusion: The invariant potential is a function of |phi|^2 alone at every order (Task 2 result). Minimization therefore always fixes |phi| to a discrete value (or leaves it at 0, depending on the sign of mu^2) but never selects a direction in SU(3)_f space: the full SU(3)_f orbit of any minimum is degenerate. The 'missing information' Z39/Z40 already identified is exactly this: no SU(3)_f-invariant potential built from a single flavon can ever supply the missing directional information, at any order, because no such invariant exists to be minimized against.
